description: This file defines the CommandSchedulesController class, which handles API endpoints related to command schedule entities, including retrieval, creation, and deletion of command schedules within a RESTful API.

classes.name: CommandSchedulesController
classes.description: ASP.NET Core API controller that manages command schedule entities, providing endpoints to retrieve, create, and delete command schedules.

methods.name: GetMany
methods.description: Retrieves a list of command schedules associated with a specific command ID, ordered by creation date descending.

methods.name: CreateOne
methods.description: Creates a new command schedule for the specified command ID, after validating the model state.

methods.name: DeleteOne
methods.description: Deletes a specific command schedule by ID and command ID, with audit logging of the deletion.
